title: Switching bound for DNF formulas
statement: Let $\varphi$ be a DNF formula on $n$ Boolean coordinates whose width is at most a natural number $w$, and let $k$ be a natural number. For every restriction parameter $\delta\in[0,1]$, the probability that a random restriction leaves the associated Boolean function with decision-tree depth at least $k$ is at most $(5\delta w)^k$.
hypotheses_covered: The formula's width is at most $w$
